name: NAG, φ+1 form via attn2 (pamparamm, Anima)
plain: Same idea as NAG, but written with a different extrapolation, so the same scale number is one step stronger than in the fork family or core. The negative comes from an attention replace on cross-attention, and only the cond part of the batch is altered, with no second model class.
math:
z̃ = z₊ + φ·(z₊ − z₋)   i.e. equal to the φ form at φ+1
r = ‖z̃‖₁/‖z₊‖₁; ẑ = z̃·min(r,τ)/r
z = α·ẑ + (1−α)·z₊

props.extra_model_calls: 0 extra UNet calls; one extra attention per patched block
props.params: sd-perturbed-attention: tau=2.5, alpha=0.5, sigma_start, sigma_end; Anima: scale=2.0, tau=2.5, alpha=0.5, start_percent, end_percent

providers.author: pamparamm
providers.note: attn2 replace; no eps; takes its own negative

providers.author: hybskgks28275
providers.note: Uses normal negative tokens in batch via optimized_attention override; eps=1e-6; skip self-attention

label: from code
surprise: The two NAG camps differ by one: scale 5 here equals scale 6 in core or the fork family, so copied settings do not transfer.
